analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of axiom.co/docs covered 139 pages with 100.72% crawl completion and 91.5% overall confidence. The site contains 7 confirmed broken internal documentation links requiring immediate remediation. API reference coverage stands at 45.31% across 10 detected API pages, indicating significant gaps in API documentation. SEO/geo issues affect 25% of pages, impacting discoverability. Freshness tracking shows 89.21% of pages have last-updated metadata, demonstrating reasonable maintenance practices.
